description: This file declares factory classes and functions for PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) encoders, modulators, processors, and related components within the ocudu namespace, including configurations for hardware and software implementations.

classes.name: pdsch_encoder_factory
classes.description: Abstract base class for PDSCH encoder factories, providing a create method for encoder instances.

classes.name: pdsch_encoder_factory_sw_configuration
classes.description: Configuration structure for software-based PDSCH encoder factory, holding shared pointers to LDPC encoder, rate matcher, and segmenter factories.

classes.name: pdsch_encoder_factory_hw_configuration
classes.description: Configuration structure for hardware-accelerated PDSCH encoder factory, including CRC, segmenter, and hardware encoder factories.

classes.name: pdsch_modulator_factory
classes.description: Abstract base class for PDSCH modulator factories, providing a create method for modulator instances.

classes.name: pdsch_processor_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating PDSCH processor and validator instances, with optional logging.

classes.name: pdsch_block_processor_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating PDSCH block processor instances.

methods.name: create_pdsch_encoder_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software-based PDSCH encoder factory using provided configuration.

methods.name: create_pdsch_encoder_factory_hw
methods.description: Creates a hardware-accelerated PDSCH encoder factory with specified configuration.

methods.name: create_pdsch_modulator_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a PDSCH modulator factory for software implementation with specified component factories.

methods.name: create_pdsch_processor_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a PDSCH processor factory for software implementation with specified component factories.

methods.name: create_pdsch_block_processor_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software-based PDSCH block processor factory with specified component factories.

methods.name: create_pdsch_block_processor_factory_hw
methods.description: Creates a hardware-accelerated PDSCH block processor factory with specified component factories.

methods.name: create_pdsch_block_processor_pool_factory
methods.description: Creates a pooled PDSCH block processor factory for concurrent processing.

methods.name: create_pdsch_flexible_processor_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a flexible PDSCH processor factory for software implementation with various component factories and threading options.

methods.name: create_pdsch_processor_pool
methods.description: Creates a pool of PDSCH processors with a maximum number of processors.
